more_info.overview: This historical label names a calcium stearoyl fumarate preparation. The supplied classification places it among emulsifiers, but a compound specification that establishes the exact ester and calcium-salt composition was not confirmed. It should not be assigned the properties of sodium stearyl fumarate or a stearoyl lactylate merely because the names are similar. Manufacture, typical food examples and a preparation-specific intake limit remain unconfirmed.
